problems.problem: Makar Sankranti is based on the sun's entry into Capricorn (Makara) in the sidereal zodiac, not the winter solstice. The winter solstice occurs around 21 December, while Makar Sankranti falls around 14 January.
problems.correction: the sun's entry into Capricorn in the sidereal zodiac
problems.verifierReason: Makar Sankranti marks the Sun's sidereal entry into Capricorn (~Jan 14), not the tropical winter solstice (~Dec 21).

problems.quote: EG requires an existential premise to introduce a constant
problems.problem: Existential Generalization (EG) does not introduce constants; it infers an existential from a constant. Constants are introduced by Existential Instantiation (EI) from an existential premise.
problems.correction: EI requires an existential premise to introduce a constant
problems.verifierReason: EG infers existential from constant; EI introduces constant from existential premise. Correction is accurate.
